SUBJECT: ABYSSAL BEHEMOTH. Use the TOP-RIGHT quadrant of input 2 as the identity reference: a colossal blue sea beast with armored scales, cyan eyes and horns.
Design a unique, immense deep-ocean leviathan rising from cold water. A broad low predatory head and immensely heavy shoulders; swept-back horns; muscular forelimbs with great hooked claws planted through the water. Its body curves away into the right-hand mist. Ancient navy and blue-grey armor plates follow the anatomy in large readable groups, with a few broad scars and small areas of muted sea-green patina. Deep-set cyan eyes and a restrained cold inner gleam in the mouth. A formidable aquatic creature with a credible jaw and gill folds, not a humanoid, not a winged land dragon.
Pose: a three-quarter view, head turned slightly toward the left, one foreclaw visible in the lower right, chest emerging from the sea. Silhouette defined by heavy shoulder arches, the head and a few purposeful fins; do not add dozens of jagged spikes.
Environment: a storm-dark open ocean and distant coastal haze. Broad dark rolling water planes, a few broad foam strokes at the creature's contact with the sea, a soft blue-grey storm sky. A quiet diffuse lighter cloud behind the head gives separation. The left is mostly calm low-contrast sea and mist. Desaturated midnight blue, cold slate and deep teal, with restrained cyan eyes. Soft overcast light. No web of lightning, glittering spray, individual foam dots everywhere, coral gardens, ships or people.
